debts.title: Legacy FastAPI backend unused by dashboard
debts.resolution_es: Auditado: ningún servicio en producción (dashboard Netlify ni whatsapp-gateway slim) consume el backend. Archivado en remoto como rama 'archive/legacy-fastapi-backend' @ a41aba6 (el proxy git del entorno rechaza push de tags con 403; existe además el tag local 'legacy-fastapi-backend'). Eliminados del árbol: backend/, gateway/ (viejo), docker-compose.yml, dashboard/src/lib/api.ts (muerto) y rewrite de next.config. Decisión D016.
debts.resolution_en: Audited: no production service (Netlify dashboard nor slim whatsapp-gateway) consumes the backend. Archived on the remote as branch 'archive/legacy-fastapi-backend' @ a41aba6 (the environment git proxy rejects tag pushes with 403; a local tag 'legacy-fastapi-backend' also exists). Removed from tree: backend/, gateway/ (old), docker-compose.yml, dead dashboard/src/lib/api.ts and the next.config rewrite. See decision D016.
debts.description_es: El backend FastAPI completo sigue en el repo pero el dashboard usa supabase-js directo y Edge Functions desde la Fase 8. Su capa de auth no aplica scoping multi-tenant. Candidato a borrado o archivado tras confirmar que ningún servicio (gateway, cron, scraper) lo consume.
debts.description_en: Full FastAPI backend remains in the repo but the dashboard uses supabase-js directly and Edge Functions since Fase 8. Its auth layer lacks multi-tenant scoping. Candidate for deletion or archiving after confirming no service (gateway, cron, scraper) consumes it.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Auditar consumidores → archivar o eliminar backend/ → limpiar docker-compose y ENV asociadas.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Audit consumers → archive or delete backend/ → clean docker-compose and related ENV vars.

debts.title: Schema drift — repo migrations don't reflect live users table
debts.description_es: La tabla 'users' en producción tiene 'auth_user_id' (uuid) y ya NO tiene 'hashed_password', pero ninguna migración versionada lo reflejaba. Peor aún: la migración 05 referencia users.auth_user_id en políticas de storage, por lo que una build limpia fallaba (la columna no existía hasta ese punto). 'avatar_url' SÍ estaba cubierto por 05 (no era drift).
debts.description_en: The production 'users' table has 'auth_user_id' (uuid) and no longer has 'hashed_password', but no versioned migration reflected it. Worse: migration 05 references users.auth_user_id in storage policies, so a clean build failed (the column did not exist yet). 'avatar_url' WAS already covered by 05 (not drift).
debts.resolution_es: Añadido a 04_rls_policies.sql (antes de las políticas y de 05), idempotente: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auth_user_id UUID; DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS hashed_password. Verificado contra producción vía information_schema: coincide (no-op en prod).
debts.resolution_en: Added to 04_rls_policies.sql (before the policies and before 05), idempotent: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auth_user_id UUID; DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS hashed_password. Verified against production via information_schema: matches (no-op on prod).
debts.proposed_fix_es: Migración idempotente de reconciliación ubicada antes de las dependencias.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Idempotent reconciliation migration placed before its dependents.

debts.title: RLS policies key off users.id = auth.uid() but app links via users.auth_user_id
debts.description_es: Sospecha (contra el repo): is_admin() y el scoping usarían 'id = auth.uid()' mientras la app enlaza por 'auth_user_id', rompiendo el scoping para agentes con id != auth_user_id.
debts.description_en: Suspicion (against the repo): is_admin() and scoping would use 'id = auth.uid()' while the app links via 'auth_user_id', breaking scoping for agents whose id != auth_user_id.
debts.resolution_es: FALSO en producción. Un trigger BEFORE INSERT (enforce_user_id_equals_auth) fuerza users.id := auth_user_id, por lo que id == auth_user_id == auth.uid() para todos. Además prod usa el helper current_agent_id() para el scoping. No hay bug. La discrepancia era del repo (migración 04 vieja), reconciliado en 07. Decisión D017. Sin cambios en prod.
debts.resolution_en: FALSE in production. A BEFORE INSERT trigger (enforce_user_id_equals_auth) forces users.id := auth_user_id, so id == auth_user_id == auth.uid() for everyone. Prod also scopes via the current_agent_id() helper. No bug. The discrepancy was in the repo (stale migration 04), reconciled in 07. Decision D017. No prod changes.

debts.title: Repo↔prod drift: RLS, triggers and Google integration only in production
debts.description_es: Producción evolucionó fuera de las migraciones: is_admin()/current_agent_id, trigger de identidad, set_updated_at en 11 tablas, RLS consolidado, y la integración Google (agent_google_credentials, google_oauth_states) — nada en el repo ni en features.json. Un entorno recreado desde el repo no reproduciría prod.
debts.description_en: Production drifted out of migrations: is_admin()/current_agent_id, identity trigger, set_updated_at on 11 tables, consolidated RLS, and the Google integration (agent_google_credentials, google_oauth_states) — none in the repo or features.json. A rebuild from the repo would not reproduce prod.
debts.resolution_es: Capturado el estado vivo en migración idempotente 07_reconcile_with_prod.sql; F026 registrada; ver docs/AUDIT-2026-06-22.md. No-op sobre prod.
debts.resolution_en: Live state captured in idempotent migration 07_reconcile_with_prod.sql; F026 logged; see docs/AUDIT-2026-06-22.md. No-op on prod.

debts.title: Governance: changes applied directly to prod without versioned migrations
debts.description_es: La causa raíz de TD-007/008/009 fue aplicar DDL/RLS y features directo en Supabase sin migración versionada (viola R7). Riesgo recurrente de drift. Diff columna-por-columna repo↔prod completado 2026-06-23 (15 tablas en asistente_real_state): única columna faltante era events.google_event_id → añadida en migración 07; resto del esquema coincide. Pendiente: gobernanza de proceso.
debts.description_en: Root cause of TD-007/008/009 was applying DDL/RLS and features directly in Supabase without a versioned migration (violates R7). Recurring drift risk. Column-level repo↔prod diff completed 2026-06-23 (15 tables in asistente_real_state): only missing column was events.google_event_id → added in migration 07; rest of the schema matches. Remaining: process governance.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Disciplina: toda evolución de esquema/RLS entra primero como migración en db/migrations/ y luego se aplica; auditoría periódica repo↔prod.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Discipline: every schema/RLS change lands first as a migration in db/migrations/ then is applied; periodic repo↔prod audit.

debts.title: Edge Function drift between repo and deployed prod
debts.description_es: Prod desplegaba solo create-agent + wa-gateway. (1) wa-gateway no estaba en el repo → AÑADIDO. (2) match-properties y notify-agent → DESPLEGADAS 2026-06-23 (v1; lógica F021 corregida, ver TD-013); resta el pipeline de embeddings (TD-014). (3) No existe Edge Function del flujo OAuth de Google → F026 sigue siendo solo esquema (parcial). Único pendiente de despliegue: la función OAuth de Google.
debts.description_en: Prod previously deployed only create-agent + wa-gateway. (1) wa-gateway was not in the repo → ADDED. (2) match-properties and notify-agent → DEPLOYED 2026-06-23 (v1; F021 logic fixed, see TD-013); embedding pipeline remains (TD-014). (3) No Edge Function implements the Google OAuth flow → F026 stays schema-only (partial). Only remaining deploy gap: the Google OAuth function.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Implementar+desplegar la función OAuth de Google para completar F026, o marcarla explícitamente como diferida.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Implement+deploy the Google OAuth function to complete F026, or explicitly defer it.

debts.title: wa-gateway /buscar queries non-existent properties.is_active → search errors
debts.resolution_es: Cambiado .eq('is_active', true) por .eq('status', 'available') en la consulta a properties; wa-gateway redesplegado a prod (v5, verify_jwt=false preservado). Validado contra prod: 'status' es columna real y la consulta es válida.
debts.resolution_en: Changed .eq('is_active', true) to .eq('status', 'available') in the properties query; wa-gateway redeployed to prod (v5, verify_jwt=false preserved). Validated against prod: 'status' is a real column and the query is well-formed.
debts.description_es: El comando /buscar filtra properties con .eq('is_active', true), pero la tabla properties NO tiene columna is_active (usa 'status', default 'available'). PostgREST devuelve error → el bot responde 'Error al buscar'. La verificación de número registrado (whatsapp_numbers.is_active, que sí existe) funciona; la búsqueda de propiedades no. Detectado en el diff columna-por-columna repo↔prod. El código del repo es fiel a prod (mismo bug desplegado).
debts.description_en: The /buscar command filters properties with .eq('is_active', true), but the properties table has NO is_active column (it uses 'status', default 'available'). PostgREST errors → the bot replies 'Error al buscar'. The registered-number check (whatsapp_numbers.is_active, which does exist) works; property search does not. Found via the column-level repo↔prod diff. Repo code is faithful to prod (same deployed bug).
debts.proposed_fix_es: Reemplazar .eq('is_active', true) por .eq('status', 'available') en la consulta a properties y redesplegar wa-gateway (toca prod → requiere OK del usuario).
debts.proposed_fix_en: Replace .eq('is_active', true) with .eq('status', 'available') in the properties query and redeploy wa-gateway (touches prod → requires user OK).

debts.title: F021 cross-agent matching chain is broken against the real schema (not just undeployed)
debts.resolution_es: Corregido y desplegado: (1) RPC find_cross_agent_matches reescrito (vector(768), clients.assigned_agent_id, clients.preference_embedding, search_path incluye public para el operador <=>, filtro client_type buyer/both) y aplicado a prod (smoke test: 0 filas, sin error). (2) match-properties v1 con columnas correctas (buyer_client_id/buyer_agent_id/match_score/match_explanation/buyer_client_name). (3) notify-agent v1 envía Authorization service-role a wa-gateway /send, y wa-gateway v6 acepta la service-role key como caller interno. Remanente (datos/infra, no código) → TD-014.
debts.resolution_en: Fixed and deployed: (1) RPC find_cross_agent_matches rewritten (vector(768), clients.assigned_agent_id, clients.preference_embedding, search_path includes public for the <=> operator, client_type buyer/both filter) and applied to prod (smoke test: 0 rows, no error). (2) match-properties v1 with correct columns (buyer_client_id/buyer_agent_id/match_score/match_explanation/buyer_client_name). (3) notify-agent v1 sends a service-role Authorization to wa-gateway /send, and wa-gateway v6 accepts the service-role key as an internal caller. Remaining (data/infra, not code) → TD-014.
debts.description_es: Auditoría F021: deshacer la suposición 'código listo, solo falta deploy'. Defectos encadenados: (1) RPC find_cross_agent_matches NO existe en prod, y la def del repo (mig 06) no compila contra el esquema real: declara p_embedding vector(1536) pero los embeddings son vector(768); usa clients.agent_id (no existe → es assigned_agent_id) y clients.embedding (no existe → es preference_embedding). (2) match-properties inserta en cross_agent_matches columnas inexistentes: client_id→buyer_client_id, client_agent_id→buyer_agent_id, similarity_score→match_score, explanation→match_explanation (y el dedup .eq('client_id') igual). (3) notify-agent hace POST a wa-gateway /send SIN header Authorization, pero /send exige un JWT de usuario → 401. (4) No hay pipeline que pueble properties.embedding / clients.preference_embedding, y properties está vacía. Conclusión: desplegar tal cual = funciones que dan 500.
debts.description_en: F021 audit: debunks the 'code ready, just needs deploy' assumption. Chained defects: (1) RPC find_cross_agent_matches does NOT exist in prod, and the repo def (mig 06) won't compile against the real schema: declares p_embedding vector(1536) but embeddings are vector(768); uses clients.agent_id (missing → it's assigned_agent_id) and clients.embedding (missing → it's preference_embedding). (2) match-properties inserts non-existent cross_agent_matches columns: client_id→buyer_client_id, client_agent_id→buyer_agent_id, similarity_score→match_score, explanation→match_explanation (dedup .eq('client_id') too). (3) notify-agent POSTs to wa-gateway /send WITHOUT an Authorization header, but /send requires a user JWT → 401. (4) No pipeline populates properties.embedding / clients.preference_embedding, and properties is empty. Conclusion: deploying as-is = functions that 500.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Trabajo real de implementación (no un deploy): corregir mig 06 (vector(768), assigned_agent_id, preference_embedding) y reaplicar; corregir nombres de columnas en match-properties; resolver auth entre funciones (service-role token o ruta interna) en notify-agent; definir el pipeline de embeddings y datos de prueba. Recién entonces desplegar.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Real implementation work (not a deploy): fix mig 06 (vector(768), assigned_agent_id, preference_embedding) and re-apply; fix column names in match-properties; resolve function-to-function auth (service-role token or internal route) in notify-agent; define the embedding pipeline and seed data. Only then deploy.

debts.title: No embedding pipeline reachable from serverless → F021 produces no matches
debts.decision: 2026-06-23: provider = Google text-embedding-004 (768-dim, no column migration).
debts.progress: embed-property v1 DEPLOYED (Gemini text-embedding-004 → properties.embedding/clients.preference_embedding, then fires match-properties). Remaining = config + integration only: set GEMINI_API_KEY secret; wire dashboard to call embed-property on property/client write; set WHATSAPP_GATEWAY_URL. Not validated end-to-end (no API key in this session).
debts.description_es: Los embeddings son vector(768), dimensión de Ollama nomic-embed-text (servicio 'ollama:11434', host interno del stack docker/Celery archivado en TD-006). Desde Edge Functions serverless ese host NO es alcanzable, así que nada puebla properties.embedding ni clients.preference_embedding → find_cross_agent_matches no encuentra candidatos y match-properties devuelve []. Además falta el disparador que llame a match-properties al crear/embeddear una propiedad, y la env var WHATSAPP_GATEWAY_URL (=${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/wa-gateway) para que salga la notificación WhatsApp.
debts.description_en: Embeddings are vector(768), the dimension of Ollama nomic-embed-text (service 'ollama:11434', the internal host of the archived docker/Celery stack from TD-006). From serverless Edge Functions that host is NOT reachable, so nothing populates properties.embedding or clients.preference_embedding → find_cross_agent_matches finds no candidates and match-properties returns []. Also missing: the trigger that calls match-properties when a property is created/embedded, and the WHATSAPP_GATEWAY_URL env var (=${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/wa-gateway) so the WhatsApp push can fire.
debts.proposed_fix_es: Decisión de proveedor de embeddings 768-dim alcanzable por HTTPS (recomendado: Google text-embedding-004, 768, ya hay integración Google; alt: Ollama hosteado público u OpenAI con otra dimensión → migrar columnas). Luego: función embed-on-write (trigger o llamada del dashboard) que escribe el vector y dispara match-properties; setear WHATSAPP_GATEWAY_URL.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Pick a 768-dim embedding provider reachable over HTTPS (recommended: Google text-embedding-004, 768, Google is already integrated; alt: a public hosted Ollama, or OpenAI at a different dim → migrate columns). Then: an embed-on-write function (trigger or dashboard call) that writes the vector and fires match-properties; set WHATSAPP_GATEWAY_URL.
